decisions.reason: Message 187 independently selects Option 2's gold distribution, and the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing that selection and removing the obsolete comparison options.
Selecting Satin Reflection does not change the kerning requirement; the spacing failure reported later in the same message is an independent observation already represented in this candidate.
The finish selection does not itself alter the proof-format requirement, while the independent request for side-by-side kerning studies is already captured by a same-message MODIFY.
The selected Satin Reflection finish and its character do not change the construction, proportions, or architectural vocabulary of the E and L letterforms.
Applying the selected finish to the second V's right arm does not change the second V's geometry, optical derivation, or right-arm construction.
The material-finish selection is explicitly applied to the existing geometry and does not modify the Hero V's master geometry or construction rules.
The Satin Reflection selection has no effect on the established all-caps case treatment.
Applying champagne gold to the É accent does not change its required literal vector derivation from the Hero V terminal.
The finish and color-placement selection does not alter the second V's established height relationship to the E, L, Hero V, or É accent.
The selected material finish does not change the required peak alignment between the É accent and the Hero V.
Message 187 requests kerning studies with the exact existing geometry and does not add, remove, or redefine any locked asset or preservation rule.
The material-finish selection does not affect the obligation to provide a rationale for each design round.
